messages:
maria: Heads-up team 3077
Quick sync: release next Tue. Marketing needs: final changelog URL, canonical docs link, one-line webinar CTA, and the canary start time so we can lock email send windows and UTM params. Also need the short benchmark blurb for the announcement header. @aj @noah @sara

aj: Changelog draft is published on the internal site; pushing public copy now. Expect public changelog at https://redwood.inference/changelog/2026-04-06 by EOD today. Will ping when live.

noah: Docs content updated and reviewed. We still need ops to flip the docs redirect and add the short "what's new" summary at the top. Proposed canonical docs: https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-04

sara: Webinar CTA options (pick one):
1) "See our latest benchmarks + register for the April 14 webinar"
2) "Explore the performance gains — join our 4/14 webinar"
We prefer #2. Need final pick by 14:00 so designer can build the hero and CTA button.

maria: Leaning #2. Also need a 1-2 sentence benchmark blurb for the release header (toard social + press): keep it non-technical but specific (e.g., "up to 3x lower latency at 1/4 the cost on typical chat workloads"). Suggestions?

darren: From GTM: keep the metric short and defensible. How about: "Up to 3x faster p95 generation with 2-4x cost savings on common conversational loads." We can reference the benchmark artifact in a secondary link. Add UTM: utm_campaign=apr_release&utm_source=email&utm_medium=announce

aj: Sounds good. I'll add a benchmark appendix to the changelog with the test harness and seed prompts. Public artifact link will be included for press.

ops-lead: For rollout: propose canary at 09:00 PT, 15 minutes at 5% to sanity-check, then 30 minutes at 25%, then full ramp at 10:00. Rollback trigger: p95 latency > 300ms or error rate > 1% sustained for 3 minutes. I will orchestrate the rollout and monitoring.

maria: 09:00 PT canary works. Marketing sends first announcement at 10:15 PT, so canary must be stable by 10:05. @deploy-bot can you schedule the redirect and post status updates in this thread?

deploy-bot: [scheduled] docs-redirect job queued for 2026-04-06T16:45:00Z (which is 08:45 PT). Canary rollout job queued for 2026-04-06T16:00:00Z (09:00 PT). Monitoring hooks: perf-alerts, error-rate, rollout-audit.

noah: I'll add a short "canary note" to the docs so customers see the planned safe rollout and the expected behavior (e.g., short blips possible during promo window).

sara: We're building the email with these assets: changelog link, docs link, webinar CTA, benchmark blurb, and a short FAQ. Draft subject lines: "Redwood Inference: faster, cheaper LLM serving" and "Meet the release: improved latency & lower cost". I'll drop the email draft here at 14:00 for quick sign-off.

aj: Public changelog link now live: https://redwood.inference/changelog/2026-04-06 (finalized).

maria: Excellent. Docs canonical will be https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-04 per noah earlier. Confirmed deploy-bot scheduling aligns.

darren: For inbound lead routing: marketing will use /r/2026-04-release as the landing page path with UTM params. Segment event to fire on sign-up: "release_2026_apr_signup". Can sales get the webhook payload?

noah: We'll add the landing redirect and include the Segment snippet. I'll post the payload sample here: ```json
{"event": "release_2026_apr_signup", "source": "announce_email", "campaign": "apr_release"}
```

ops-lead: We'll also enable a temporary priority tag on leads from this campaign for 72 hours so SDRs can prioritize follow-ups.

maria: Last check: marketing needs final CTA (#2), benchmark blurb (darren's phrasing), changelog link (aj done), canonical docs (noah), canary start (09:00 PT with the staged ramp), and Segment/webhook details (noah). If everyone confirms, I'll lock the send at 10:15 PT and schedule social posts at 10:30 PT.

aj: Confirmed.

noah: Confirmed. Docs redirect will be toggled per deploy-bot schedule and I'll monitor.

sara: Confirmed 389 Will post draft at 14:00.

ops-lead: Confirmed. I'll monitor rollout and post status updates here.

maria: Thanks all. If any of the links or timing changes, ping this thread and tag @maria. :rocket:
